description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s, professional and authoritative appearance. He is wearing a crisp, dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including the formal peaked cap, insignia on the shoulders, and polished black boots. He has a clean-shaven face and a short, neat haircut.

FULL BODY. A retired Malaysian male in his late 60s with silver-gray hair and a gentle expression. He is wearing a traditional light blue Baju Melayu top with dark trousers and simple indoor sandals. He has a slim build and a kind, elderly appearance.

FULL BODY. An anonymous and featureless human silhouette standing in a dark void. The figure has glowing red digital binary code flowing across its surface to represent a cyber-criminal. The shape is human-like but lacks any facial features or skin, wearing a dark hooded cloak that obscures its form.
